# Expo

One e2e smoke runner. For Maestro that command is `mobile:e2e` (or the headless script a person watches). It is not part of `pnpm check` or `make check`. Do not add a second Maestro job. `.helmsman/tools/expo/doctor.sh` runs only when `HELMSMAN_EXPO_DOCTOR=1`.
